releases.title: Pong build 2 (44ae1c8 + artist e3bead3): unskippable winner screen, computer wins points
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
Game: game-developer 44ae1c8ff08eb4a95077946205ea39c2e0b2c8b6. Assets: artist e3bead3114349f338d97e4400c58f23ed17d2f4b. This is the `ht-role delivery` assembly.

**Start:** unzip pong-build2.zip and open pong-build2/index.html in a desktop browser, or run `python3 -m http.server` in that folder.

**Controls:** W/S or ↑/↓ to move. Enter, Space or click to start and to play again (the end screen ignores input for its first second). P or Esc to pause, M to toggle sound.

**Changes since build-1:**
- The winner screen can't be skipped (#7).
- The play-again prompt is steady instead of blinking.
- The title screen's demo rally is drawn fainter behind the text.
- The computer aims 35% of its returns away from your paddle, hit 1.45× harder, so it takes points from attentive players (#8 F2).

**Checks:** in `checks/runs/rev2/`.

releases.title: Pong build 1 (a7bc95f game + artist 92b3b8e assets)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
Playable Pong, all of R1-R9. Game code is game-developer a7bc95f2f1d393fbce150f265e06861cb7fc00e2; the tag points at 015fd093e2bc960aa6c7b81496d7795ef394fcd7, which only adds check captures. Assets are artist 92b3b8e2f66c0b127388dca16b270890e9eb8c17.

**Start:** download pong-build1.zip, unzip it and open pong-build1/index.html in a desktop browser. Or run python3 -m http.server inside pong-build1 and open http://localhost:8000/.

**Controls:** W/S or Arrow Up/Down to move the left paddle. Enter, Space or click to start and to play again. P or Esc to pause. M toggles sound.

**Checked:** headless Chromium on the delivery assembly, all checks passed with no page errors. Log and screenshots are in checks/runs/a7bc95f/.
